text: The chest X-ray showing hyperinflated lungs with an increased anterior-posterior diameter is highly suggestive of emphysema or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Given your history of a productive cough with green phlegm and worsening shortness of breath on exertion, do you have a history of long-term smoking or exposure to significant dust or chemical fumes?

text: Yes, I've been smoking for about 25 years, and I work as a mechanic, so I'm exposed to dust and fumes regularly. I don't recall any specific incidents of heavy chemical exposure, but I do notice the cough gets worse when I'm around those fumes at work.

speaker: Doctor
